summary: Architectural and visual design plan for CLUB No.9 (九号俱乐部), an isometric 3D pixel-art retro lounge and physics game hub featuring Ludo (Club No.9 Edition), 8-Ball Pool, Pixel Darts, and Liar's Dice Cup, complete with living NPC patrons, procedural Web Audio synthesis, bilingual i18n, and PeerJS WebRTC multiplayer.
